news.headline: NVIDIA Or Micron: Which Gets Paid More Safely For The AI Shortage?
news.summary: If you own NVIDIA (NVDA) or Micron Technology (MU), you own the same idea: AI data centers want more chips and memory than the industry can supply. The two split from there.
